metadata.description: Metis Foundry plugins for Claude Code: Metis Check settles the citations in an answer at the registries that issue them.

plugins.name: metis-check
plugins.description: Check citations and identifiers at the source: DOI, PubMed, arXiv, ORCID, ROR, ISBN, LEI, ISIN, CUSIP, SEC CIK, EIN, NPI, UK company numbers, domains and U.S. case citations. One of four states per identifier, a signed report anyone can recheck. Free for 5 checks a month.
